# kombify Techstack

> The optional operator app on top of StackKits: guided configuration (Easy and Techie), runtime and service inventory across servers, orchestration of a pinned StackKits CLI and governed Day-2 operations. Beta.

- StackKits keeps owning stack definitions and the standalone lifecycle; Techstack never replaces it.
- The open-source Windows client works account-free against a server in your home network. This hosted entry and the managed capabilities are preview scope.
- Public HTTPS names for services come from kombify.me.
